description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'git mktag' functionality, which deals with creating and verifying tag objects in Git. It includes setup procedures, various test cases covering length checks, header validations, object type and hash verifications, tag name rules, date and timezone validations, and configurations for error reporting. The script also contains functions for checking verification failures and success tests with different scenarios.

methods.name: check_verify_failure
methods.description: A helper function that runs verification on a tag signature file expecting failure with specific error patterns.
